name: BITEZ XL - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 4000MG Gummies - Cosmic Berry
description:
*DOUBLE THE STRENGTH OF OUR REGULAR BITEZ GUMMIES!

Blast off into bold berry flavor with Cosmic Berry XL BITEZ Gummies. Each double-stacked gummy delivers a wild fusion of tart mountain berries with that sweet candy taste you crave. Packed with vibrant berry flavor and our most powerful XL formula yet, Cosmic Berry is infused with a Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend, delivering 2,000mg per piece (2 gummies per bag, 4,000mg total)
